_readme: Load-bearing figures of mexico-invest.com. A figure phrase used in two or more articles is a corpus-wide claim and must be registered here with its source; a figure used once is a local worked example and needs no entry. Entries are grouped per figure: one number carries more than one meaning across the corpus. Statutory figures cite the statute; market-model figures cite the survey or model behind them and say so plainly, because pretending a modelled band is a law would be the exact failure this registry exists to prevent.
